_om: English translation of handelser.json. Texts only; the numbers stand in the Swedish file. The events are matched by their ids.

lista.bok: A new door opens between two rooms that are already there.
text: The walls draw breath. To the {horn} stone grinds on stone, and where there was a wall there is now an opening.
har: The wall beside you slides aside with a long breath. There is an opening there now.

lista.bok: Gold pours out into a room no one has been in yet.
text: Somewhere to the {horn} a wall cracks, and coins rattle down onto a floor.
har: The wall cracks beside you, and coins rattle down around your feet.

lista.bok: For three rounds the darkness does not bite anyone.
text: The sun finds a way through the slits. A pale light falls through the whole tower, and the darkness draws back for a while.

lista.bok: The serpent's shed skin ends up in a room no one has been in yet. It is worth gold, but not without a catch.
text: To the {horn} something dry and thin rustles. The serpent has shed its skin.
har: A dry, translucent skin slides down the wall beside you.

lista.bok: A room someone has walked through cannot be entered for three rounds. Whoever stood there loses a life and falls into the vaults.
text: To the {horn} a ceiling caves in with a roar. No one can get into that room for a while.
har: The ceiling caves in on you! The floor gives way, and you fall into the vaults.

lista.bok: A creature of white bones rises where someone has died.
text: To the {horn}, where someone died, something of white bone rises.
har: Where someone died, something of white bone rises right beside you.

lista.bok: The sun sinks a hand's breadth, and whoever stands in the chamber gets a handful that does not wake the serpent.
text: A bell strikes somewhere deep in the tower, a single stroke. The light outside turns redder.
har: At the stroke of the bell the serpent's breathing stops short. The next handful you take will not wake it.

lista.bok: The sun does not sink that round.
text: The bell at the top of the tower falls silent in the middle of a stroke. The light in the slits stands still, and the sun does not sink this time.

lista.bok: Whoever carries no light is left in darkness for a round.
text: A cold draught moves through the tower. The torches flicker and go out one by one, and the darkness closes in.

lista.bok: Everyone hears in which direction the one carrying the most gold stands, but not who it is.
text: To the {horn} coins jingle in a heavy purse. Someone there carries more than anyone else.
har: Your purse jingles so loudly that it echoes between the walls. Everyone in the tower heard it.
bredvid: The purse beside you jingles so loudly that it echoes between the walls. Whoever carries it has more than anyone else.

lista.bok: An item or a letter ends up in a room no one has been in yet.
text: To the {horn} something heavy falls from a hole in the ceiling and lands with a thud.
har: A pack falls from the ceiling at your feet. Someone who walked here before you never came back for it.

lista.bok: A wanderer gets a letter under the door. Only they notice it.
har: A sheet of paper slides in under the door, as if someone on the other side pushed it through.

lista.bok: A door between two rooms closes for three rounds, but only where there is another way between them.
text: To the {horn} stone grinds on stone, and an opening closes.
har: The door beside you slides shut with a heavy breath. It will not budge.

lista.bok: Something long and hissing crawls out of the wall next to whoever stands alone furthest from the gates. Only they notice it.
har: The mortar crumbles, and something small and writhing crawls out of the wall beside you.

lista.bok: The serpent's deck gets two new cards, which may let it sleep or wake it. Everyone notices that the serpent stirs.
text: Something huge turns over in its sleep deep inside the tower. The floor trembles faintly under your feet.
har: The serpent sighs in its sleep and sinks deeper. The coils lie still around the gold.
har_annars: The serpent stirs restlessly in its sleep. Its eyelids twitch, and the coils tighten around the gold.

lista.bok: Those standing near the chamber see vermin coming from that direction. Only they notice it.
har: A tide of small black vermin pours in from the {horn}, rushes past your feet and vanishes the other way. Something over there frightened them.
